item: The pressure-light member says what the sampler watched so an empty ring explains itself
summary: The October zips said taken null with no snapshots, which reads the same as a dead sampler; it was running and nothing it watches had crossed (lowest available 3073 MB against a 1005 MB line, RSS 49.7% against 56.7%). Each session block now carries liveness checks run, lowest available MB, highest swap, RSS and RSS share (each with when) and the lines in force at the last check, from marks the liveness tick keeps; a reading never taken is null, not zero. About 890 bytes added to the member's fixed part for both sessions; the ring is cut to what remains of the slot.
